entries.zh: 相思病；因思念郁结成疾
entries.en: lovesickness; melancholy brought on by longing, and the illness it causes

entries.zh: 相思病；因离别思念而生的郁疾
entries.en: lovesickness; the melancholy of longing and separation
melancholy, gloom; sorrow pent up in the heart
grief lodged in the heart; deep, consuming melancholy

entries.zh: 愁苦憔悴之貌；面色晦暗、形容萎顿
entries.en: woebegone and haggard; of darkened, drawn countenance
entries.notes: H 为形容愁苦憔悴之貌的熟语，与 L melancólico 义合但不逐字对应，故降为 medium。

entries.zh: 冰糖；熬制的糖膏、糖稀（西语 melcocha）
entries.en: rock sugar; (Sp. melcocha) a boiled sugar-and-honey taffy or syrup
entries.notes: L melcocha 指熬炼的软糖膏，与 H 冰糖（结晶糖）非严格对等，属当时以糖类制品互释。

entries.zh: 扭捏作态；妇人的娇柔做作
entries.en: affectation, mincing airs (such as a woman's); daintiness
entries.notes: L 末作「como de mug.」即 mujer，指妇人之态；H「做骸」为稀见搭配，义据 L 与 M 音读推定。

entries.zh: 挑剔难伺候的；体弱多病的；总不称心的
entries.en: fastidious and hard to please; sickly, ailing; never content
entries.notes: M 栏后半为墨团涂损不可辨，H 疑为「細辛/細莘」待考，释义仅赖 L 栏三项西语义。

entries.en: notch, chip; a chipped or broken-off edge

entries.notes: L 末「devivien re.」当为 de un vientre；M 栏多音污损，H「胞胎」本指胎胞，此处取同胎双生义。

entries.en: twins; born together as a pair
entries.notes: H 首字疑「甲/早」未定，M 栏半损，仅据 L「nacidos juntos」定其双生义。

entries.zh: 同日所生的双生子；同生日
entries.en: twins born on the same day; of one birthday
entries.notes: R 栏所书「en un dia」为西语而非官话对音，M 栏末三音涂损，H 与 L 仍相合。
